'''2008 Endor Regionals''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG regional championship played on Saturday 13 September 2008 at First Pick Games, 4228 Stone Way N., Seattle, Washington, organized by [[Chris Wirfs]] with [[Michael Erisman]] as tournament director.<ref name="pcf-21444-308744">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=308744#308744 Endor Regionals], Chris Wirfs (itcouldbewirfs), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (21 June 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080915153804/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=21444 Internet Archive]</ref> It was a Championship-level constructed event starting at 10:00 am, with decklists required and a $5 entry fee; prizes depended on the number of entries, and two byes into the [[2008 World Championship|World Championship]] were at stake. Wirfs wrote that he had "about $100 worth of Prize Support left over from States".<ref name="pcf-21444-308744" />

== Planning ==

On 23 June 2008 Erisman listed the 2008 World Championship bye opportunities in the Endor region as the Washington, Oregon and Idaho state championships, Endor Regionals, the Seattle League and the Coast League.<ref name="pcf-21444-309303">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=309303#309303 Endor Regionals], Michael Erisman (mserisman), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (23 June 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080915153804/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=21444 Internet Archive]</ref> On 30 June [[Mike French]] noted that regionals carried two byes, making seven in all.<ref name="pcf-21444-311404">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=311404#311404 Endor Regionals], Mike French (mikefrench), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (30 June 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080915153804/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=21444 Internet Archive]</ref> The same day Wirfs proposed September for the event, at a site in the south end of Puget Sound such as Tacoma or Olympia,<ref name="pcf-21444-311355">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=311355#311355 Endor Regionals], Chris Wirfs (itcouldbewirfs), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (30 June 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080915153804/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=21444 Internet Archive]</ref> while Erisman argued for north Seattle, where more players lived, unless enough Oregon players were guaranteed to drive up.<ref name="pcf-21444-311392">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=311392#311392 Endor Regionals], Michael Erisman (mserisman), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (30 June 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080915153804/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=21444 Internet Archive]</ref> On 17 July Wirfs set the date as Saturday 13 September 2008.<ref name="pcf-21444-316163">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=316163#316163 Endor Regionals], Chris Wirfs (itcouldbewirfs), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (17 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080915153804/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=21444 Internet Archive]</ref> After winning the 2008 Washington State Championship on 19 July 2008, [[Steve Harpster]] wrote that he would be "hosting Regionals so others can get a bye".<ref name="sf-20536-316618">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=316618#p316618 Washington State Championship - discussion], Harpster (Steve Harpster), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (20 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125181728/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20536-start160.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sf-22883-332133">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=332133#p332133 List of People who have Worlds Day Two Auto Bids 2008], simone89, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (29 August 2008).</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' First Pick Games, 4228 Stone Way N., Seattle, Washington<ref name="pcf-21444-308744" />
* '''Dates:''' 13 September 2008<ref name="pcf-21444-308744" /><ref name="pcf-21444-316163" />
* '''Time:''' 10:00 am<ref name="pcf-21444-308744" />
* '''Format:''' constructed, Championship level; decklists required<ref name="pcf-21444-308744" />
* '''Entry:''' $5<ref name="pcf-21444-308744" />
* '''Organizer:''' [[Chris Wirfs]]<ref name="pcf-21444-308744" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Michael Erisman]]<ref name="pcf-21444-308744" />

== Results ==

No results were posted in the Players Committee forum topic. In the forum's capture of 15 September 2008, the signature of the player posting as Harpster lists "2008 Endor Regional Champion", together with 2008 Washington State Champion, 2008 Federal Way Mini Open Champion and 2008 Seattle Summer League Champion.<ref name="pcf-21444-308754">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=308754#308754 Endor Regionals], Harpster, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (21 June 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080915153804/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=21444 Internet Archive]</ref>
